composition.description: The composition in the format Element:ratio,Element:ratio (e.g., Zr:1,O:2; Ti:0.5,Al:0.5,N:1). Do NOT leave this field empty.

space_group.description: Space group notation (e.g., P2_1/c, P4_2/nmc, Fm-3m, P6_3/mmc, R-3c)

number_of_atoms.description: Total number of atoms in the unit cell (e.g., 3, 5, 8, 12). Leave empty if not mentioned

K_points.description: K-point mesh or sampling scheme (e.g., 6 9 6 9 6; 4×4×4; Monkhorst-Pack 6×6×6). Leave empty if not mentioned

theoretical_calculation_method.description: The theoretical method used (e.g., DFT, DFT+U, DFT-D, hybrid DFT). Leave empty if not mentioned

total_energy.description: Total energy of the system with units (e.g., -1234.56 eV; -5678.90 eV/cell; -12.3456 Ry). Leave empty if not mentioned

formation_energy.description: Formation energy with units (e.g., -2.34 eV/atom; -1.23 eV/formula unit). Leave empty if not mentioned

cohesive_energy.description: Cohesive energy with units (e.g., -5.67 eV/atom; -8.90 eV). Leave empty if not mentioned

thermal_expansion_coefficient.description: Thermal expansion coefficient with units (e.g., 2.5×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹; α=3.2×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹). Leave empty if not mentioned

phonon_DOS.description: Phonon density of states description or values (e.g., phonon DOS calculated; peaks at...). Leave empty if not mentioned

phonon.description: Phonon frequency or dispersion information (e.g., ω_max=15.2 THz; dispersion curves). Leave empty if not mentioned

vibrational_entropy.description: Vibrational entropy with units (e.g., 5.67 J/mol·K; 0.023 eV/K). Leave empty if not mentioned

heat_capacity.description: Heat capacity with units (e.g., 25.3 J/mol·K; C_v=24.5 J/mol·K at 300 K). Leave empty if not mentioned

diffusion_coefficient.description: Diffusion coefficient with units (e.g., 1.2×10⁻¹² m²/s; D=3.4×10⁻¹³ m²/s). Leave empty if not mentioned

density.description: Density value with units if provided (e.g., 5.68 g/cm³; ρ=4.23 g/cm³). Leave empty if not mentioned
